question: If $F(x)$ is an anti-derivative of $f(x)$, which of the following also represents an anti-derivative of $f(x)$?
explanation:
All antiderivatives of a function differ by a constant.

If $F(x)$ is an antiderivative, then $F(x)+C$ is also an antiderivative of $f(x)$.
